mcqs.question: National Maritime Day is observed on which date, commemorating the voyage of SS Loyalty?
mcqs.explanation: National Maritime Day is observed on April 5, commemorating SS Loyalty’s Mumbai–London voyage on April 5, 1919. April 6 is associated with the International Day of Sport for Development and Peace.

mcqs.question: What was the theme of World Homoeopathy Day in April 2026?
options: Together for health. Stand with science.
Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must.
mcqs.explanation: The theme of World Homoeopathy Day was “Homoeopathy for Sustainable Health.” “Together for health. Stand with science.” was the World Health Day theme.

mcqs.question: What was the significant development associated with World Quantum Day in April 2026?
options: AP quantum test beds were launched
A quantum clock was installed at Kashi Vishwanath Temple
A semiconductor fab was approved at Dholera
A permanent nuclear waste repository was opened in Finland
mcqs.explanation: AP quantum test beds were launched in connection with World Quantum Day. The Kashi Vishwanath Temple fact concerns the Vikramaditya Vedic Clock, while the semiconductor fab concerns Dholera.

mcqs.question: Which organisation was associated with World Heritage Day and the 2026 theme “Emergency Response for Living Heritage in Contexts of Conflicts and Disasters”?
mcqs.explanation: ICOMOS was associated with World Heritage Day and the stated 2026 theme. ILO was associated with the World Day for Safety and Health at Work.

mcqs.question: Satellite Technology Day commemorates the launch of which satellite on April 19, 1975?
mcqs.explanation: Satellite Technology Day commemorates the launch of Aryabhata on April 19, 1975. SS Loyalty is linked with National Maritime Day, while Onkalo is a nuclear waste repository.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about April 2026 observances are correct?
1. World Malaria Day had the theme “Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must.”
2. World Malaria Day was associated with 47 malaria-free countries.
3. International Day of Plant Health had the theme “Locally adapted seeds, community seed systems.”
4. International Day of Plant Health had the theme “Homoeopathy for Sustainable Health.”
mcqs.explanation: Exactly two statements are correct: statements 1 and 3. The malaria-related figure was 47 malaria-free countries, while “Homoeopathy for Sustainable Health” was the World Homoeopathy Day theme.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The International Labour Organization was associated with the World Day for Safety and Health at Work.
Statement B: The World Day for Safety and Health at Work was associated with ICOMOS.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true because the International Labour Organization was associated with the World Day for Safety and Health at Work. Statement B is false because ICOMOS was associated with World Heritage Day.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the April 2026 current-affairs facts.

List-I
 a. India’s coastline
 b. Major ports in India
 c. Sagarmala
 d. Director-General of UNESCO

List-II
 i. Khaled El Enany
 ii. 13
 iii. 7,516 km
 iv. 2015
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-ii, c-iv and d-i: India’s coastline is 7,516 km, there are 13 major ports, Sagarmala dates to 2015, and Khaled El Enany is the UNESCO Director-General. The other codes interchange these facts.

mcqs.question: Where was India’s first water-neutral railway depot established?
mcqs.explanation: India’s first water-neutral railway depot was established at the Kankaria coaching depot in Ahmedabad. Samba was the location of the alkaline battery unit, while Info Valley was the location of the 3D semiconductor packaging unit.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about India’s first operational alkaline battery unit is incorrect?
options: It is located in Samba, Jammu.
It was inaugurated by LG Manoj Sinha.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that it was established by Eveready; the fact identifies Eveready as the organisation, so this statement is actually correct. Therefore, this option set does not contain a false statement and is invalid.

mcqs.question: India’s first advanced 3D semiconductor chip packaging unit is being established at which place?
mcqs.explanation: India’s first advanced 3D semiconductor chip packaging unit is being established at Info Valley, Bhubaneswar. Dholera is associated with the first semiconductor fab or semiconductor SEZ, while Amaravati is associated with quantum hardware test beds.

mcqs.question:
Match the firsts with their locations.

List-I
 a. Quantum hardware test beds
 b. Private gold mine
 c. Semiconductor fab or semiconductor SEZ
 d. Coal-to-ammonium nitrate project

List-II
 i. Lakhanpur, Jharsuguda
 ii. Dholera, Gujarat
 iii. Amaravati
 iv. Jonnagiri, Kurnool
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-iv, c-ii and d-i: quantum hardware test beds are at Amaravati, the private gold mine is at Jonnagiri, the semiconductor fab is at Dholera, and the coal-to-ammonium nitrate project is at Lakhanpur. The other options interchange these locations.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: NARIT AI is a RAG-based AI narcotics investigation tool of the Gujarat Police.
Statement B: Pay Point India Network received direct RTGS and NEFT access without its own IFSC.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true: NARIT AI is a RAG-based AI narcotics investigation tool of the Gujarat Police. Statement B is false because Pay Point India Network had direct RTGS and NEFT access with its own IFSC.

mcqs.question:
Match the firsts with their institutions or locations.

List-I
 a. Braille and sign language services at a passport office
 b. UNESCO Chair on Gender Inclusion and Skill Development
 c. CCRAS institute with ISO 15189:2022

List-II
 i. CARI, Bengaluru
 ii. Bhopal Regional Passport Office
 iii. Symbiosis Skills and Professional University, Pune
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iii and c-i. The Bhopal Regional Passport Office provided Braille and sign language services, the UNESCO Chair was at Symbiosis Skills and Professional University, Pune, and the CCRAS institute was CARI, Bengaluru.

mcqs.question: Which Indian organisation became the first Indian FMCG company to record a turnover of ₹1 lakh crore in FY26?
mcqs.explanation: AMUL became the first Indian FMCG company to record a turnover of ₹1 lakh crore in FY26. GCMMF’s revenue was ₹73,450 crore, a separate figure associated with AMUL.

mcqs.question:
Match the person with the distinction.

List-I
 a. Divya Singh
 b. Menaka Guruswamy

List-II
 i. First openly queer MP
 ii. First Indian woman to cycle to Everest Base Camp
mcqs.explanation: Divya Singh was the first Indian woman to cycle to Everest Base Camp, while Menaka Guruswamy was the first openly queer MP. The other options reverse or duplicate these distinctions.

mcqs.question:
Match the world firsts with their locations or associated details.

List-I
 a. Vikramaditya Vedic Clock
 b. Upper 6 GHz network, “10 Giga Nation”

List-II
 i. UAE
 ii. Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi
mcqs.explanation: The Vikramaditya Vedic Clock is at Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi, while the world’s first upper 6 GHz network, called “10 Giga Nation,” is in the UAE. The alternatives interchange or duplicate the locations.

mcqs.question:
Match the firsts or milestones with the corresponding details.

List-I
 a. First air taxi station
 b. World’s largest hydropower project
 c. Ladakh became a Union Territory
 d. Indian Railways began in

List-II
 i. 1853
 ii. Dubai, near DXB
 iii. October 31, 2019
 iv. China, on the Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibet
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iv, c-iii and d-i. The first air taxi station is planned near DXB in Dubai, the largest hydropower project is in China on the Yarlung Tsangpo, Ladakh became a Union Territory on October 31, 2019, and Indian Railways began in 1853.
